title: Project Architect
description:
**Role Summary:**

The Project Architec & Planning Engineer is responsible for preparing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules to ensure timely execution of construction activities. The role involves project planning, resource scheduling, progress monitoring, delay analysis, reporting, and coordination with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and clients to achieve project objectives within the approved timelines and budgets.

**Responsibilities:**

**Project Planning & Scheduling:**

Prepare detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Develop baseline programmes, work breakdown structures (WBS), milestones, and activity sequencing.

Prepare master schedules, look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, and catch-up programmes.

Coordinate with project teams during project planning and mobilization.

**Project Monitoring & Control:**

Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly project progress against approved schedules.

Track critical activities and identify potential delays and schedule risks.

Analyze project performance using planned vs. actual progress.

Recommend corrective and preventive actions to maintain project timelines.

**Resource Planning:**

Prepare manpower, equipment, and material deployment schedules.

Coordinate with procurement and site teams to ensure timely resource availability.

Monitor resource utilization and productivity.

**Progress Reporting:**

Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for management and clients.

Develop project dashboards, S-curves, histograms, and KPI reports.

Present schedule updates during project review meetings.

Maintain project planning documentation and records.

**Cost & Time Control:**

Support project cost monitoring by integrating schedule and cost information.

Assist in tracking project budgets against work progress.

Monitor earned value indicators where applicable.

Support preparation of cash flow forecasts linked to project schedules.

**Risk & Delay Analysis :**

Identify scheduling risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

Perform delay analysis and impact assessments.

Assist in extension of time (EOT) claims and supporting documentation.

Maintain risk registers related to project schedules.

**Coordination & Communication**

Coordinate with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, procurement, and project teams.

Participate in project coordination meetings.

Ensure planning information is communicated accurately across stakeholders.

Support management in decision-making through timely project insights.

**Documentation & Compliance :**

Maintain all planning documents, revisions, and project records.

Ensure compliance with contractual planning requirements.

Follow company project management procedures and reporting standards.

Support quality, safety, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

**Skills:**

▪ High level of ownership and accountability

▪ Team player with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.

▪ Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

▪ Excellent problem-solving and risk assessment skills.

▪ Excellent verbal and written communication skill

▪ Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

**Qualification & Experience Experience:**

2–3 years of experience in construction, infrastructure, or real estate project planning. Experience in high-rise buildings, commercial developments, mixed-use projects, or residential developments is preferred.

**Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and advanced Microsoft Excel.**

**Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. Certification in Primavera P6 is preferred. PMP or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹69,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

The Digital Transformation Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and monitoring the day-to-day activities of the Digital Transformation team. The role involves following up with Application Analysts and Application Developers, obtaining regular updates on development activities, tracking project progress and deliverables, coordinating with internal stakeholders, and maintaining accurate project documentation and status reports. The position supports the Assistant Manager by ensuring that assigned tasks progress according to agreed timelines and that delays, dependencies, and unresolved issues are escalated promptly.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Coordinate the daily activities of the Digital Transformation team and follow up on assigned tasks, pending activities, and completion timelines.
* Regularly coordinate with the development team to obtain updates on ongoing development work, completed tasks, pending items, bug fixes, and expected delivery dates.
* Track project progress, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and target completion dates using the team's project tracker.
* Follow up with Application Analysts to ensure that requirements, clarifications, and functional expectations are documented and communicated to developers.
* Coordinate between analysts, developers, end users, hospital departments, and other IT teams to facilitate timely completion of activities.
* Monitor progress on application enhancements, testing, bug fixes, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation activities.
* Identify delays, dependencies, risks, and operational bottlenecks and escalate them to the Assistant Manager.
* Organize team meetings, record meeting minutes and action items, and follow up to ensure agreed actions are completed.
* Prepare regular status reports covering completed work, ongoing activities, pending tasks, overdue items, risks, and issues requiring decisions.
* Maintain updated project documentation, task trackers, meeting records, and other relevant coordination documents.
* Follow up on pending feedback, approvals, testing results, and sign-offs required for project completion.
* Support the Assistant Manager in monitoring workloads, departmental objectives, project priorities, and process improvements.

Qualifications and Skills Required

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Good understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, development, testing, and implementation.
* Familiarity with project tracking and task management tools such as Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Lists, or similar platforms.
* Ability to track multiple tasks and projects, monitor timelines, and maintain accurate status information.
* Understanding of application development and support processes; experience working with software development teams is preferred.
* Ability to prepare clear status reports, meeting minutes, project trackers, and other documentation.

Core Competencies

* Strong coordination, organization, and follow-up skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Proactive approach to identifying delays, dependencies, and issues.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Attention to detail, accountability, and effective time management.
* Ability to work independently on coordination activities and deliver within timelines.
* Teamwork and collaboration across functions.

Experience

1–3 years of relevant experience in IT coordination, project coordination, application support, software development coordination, or a similar role.

Experience coordinating with developers, analysts, or technical teams in a healthcare or enterprise IT environment is an added advantage.

Role Scope

The role focuses on coordination, progress monitoring, follow-up, reporting, and documentation. Project priorities, resource allocation, major technical decisions, and management-level escalations remain under the authority of the Assistant Manager – Digital Transformation.

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

About the Role

Elkanio is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to take ownership of planning, coordinating, and delivering technology projects from initiation through successful completion.

You will work closely with **clients, product teams, developers, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and leadership** to ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate has **3–5 years of experience in software project management or delivery management**, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand technical discussions and translate business requirements into actionable delivery plans.

This is a hands\-on role requiring strong ownership, proactive communication, structured planning, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced technology environment.

What You'll DoProject Ownership \& Planning

* Own assigned projects and initiatives from **requirement gathering through delivery and production rollout**.
* Understand project objectives, scope, requirements, timelines, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, schedules, and delivery trackers.
* Break down requirements into actionable workstreams and coordinate execution across teams.
* Track progress against milestones and proactively address deviations.
* Coordinate releases, UAT, deployments, and post\-release activities.
* Ensure deliverables are completed within agreed scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned clients and projects.
* Establish regular communication and reporting cadence with stakeholders.
* Lead client meetings, requirement discussions, sprint reviews, demos, and status calls.
* Clearly communicate project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and upcoming milestones.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively communicate changes or potential delays.
* Ensure client decisions and requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally.
* Build strong working relationships with technical and business stakeholders.

Requirement \& Scope Management

* Work with clients and product stakeholders to understand and clarify business requirements.
* Coordinate with technical teams to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
* Support backlog prioritization and release planning.
* Identify dependencies and gaps in requirements before development begins.
* Manage changes to scope and communicate their impact on timelines, resources, and delivery.
* Maintain clear visibility of agreed scope and approved changes.
* Work with Product Owners and technical teams to ensure requirements are ready for development.

Team \& Delivery Management

* Coordinate development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, product, and other teams involved in delivery.
* Ensure teams have the required information and dependencies to execute their work.
* Track resource availability and highlight capacity or allocation constraints.
* Identify blockers and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and ensure timely handoffs.
* Support teams in maintaining focus on sprint and release objectives.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately when leadership intervention is required.

Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management

* Proactively identify and maintain visibility of **project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies**.
* Define mitigation actions with relevant stakeholders.
* Track issues through to closure and ensure clear ownership.
* Identify potential schedule, resource, technical, or scope risks early.
* Escalate critical risks and delivery concerns in a timely manner.
* Facilitate root\-cause discussions for significant or recurring delivery issues.
* Maintain appropriate risk and issue registers.

Agile \& Delivery Practices

* Work effectively with teams following **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives where required.
* Track sprint commitments, velocity, blockers, and delivery outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners and engineering teams to maintain a prioritized backlog.
* Coordinate release planning and track release readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve team processes, delivery predictability, and collaboration.

Reporting \& Governance

* Prepare regular **project status reports and management updates**.
* Provide visibility into project health, milestones, progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Track planned versus actual delivery timelines.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, action logs, and decision records.
* Provide concise and accurate updates to leadership and clients.
* Establish and maintain appropriate project governance and reporting practices.

What We're Looking For

* **3–5 years of experience** in software project management, delivery management, or a similar technology role.
* Proven experience managing software projects through the **SDLC**, from requirements through production.
* Strong understanding of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Experience managing cross\-functional technology teams.
* Strong planning, organization, prioritization, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, workstreams, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong risk, issue, dependency, and scope management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both **technical and non\-technical stakeholders**.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency with **Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, Slack, or similar project management and collaboration tools**.
* Good understanding of software development concepts, APIs, databases, testing, deployments, integrations, and production support.
* Ability to understand technical discussions and coordinate effectively with engineering teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Technical Understanding

You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding and discussing:

* Frontend and backend development
* REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Database concepts and data flows
* QA, testing, UAT, and defect management
* Cloud environments and deployment processes
* Git and software development workflows
* Production releases and incident management
* Basic system architecture and technical dependencies
* Performance, scalability, and integration considerations

Bonus Points

* Experience working on **B2B or B2C technology products**.
* Experience in **travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, fintech, or other transaction\-based domains**.
* Experience managing projects involving third\-party APIs and external integrations.
* Experience with payment gateways or booking platforms.
* Experience working with international clients or distributed teams.
* Technical background in software development, QA, business analysis, or engineering.
* Scrum Master, PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant certification.
* Experience with delivery metrics, dashboards, and project reporting.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple teams, vendors, or external technology partners.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **real\-world technology products with real users and business impact**.
* Exposure to challenging projects involving **travel technology, APIs, integrations, payments, and digital platforms**.
* Direct interaction with clients, product teams, engineering teams, and leadership.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to work across technology and business domains.
* Opportunity to develop strong expertise across **project management, Agile delivery, stakeholder management, and technology delivery**.
* Increasing ownership and career growth based on performance and capability.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
